tool.name: Get.oturep
tool.description: Generate a fasta with a representative sequence for each OTU
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat && #if $method_condition.method_switch == "distance": ln -s '$method_condition.matrix_condition.dist' dist.dat && ln -s '$method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount' nameOrCount.dat && ln -s '$method_condition.fasta' fasta.dat && #if $method_condition.pick.type == "yes": ln -s '$method_condition.pick.group' group.dat && #end if #elif $method_condition.method_switch == "abundance": ln -s '$method_condition.nameOrCount' nameOrCount.dat && #end if
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #if $sorted: #silent $mothur_args.append("sorted=" + str($sorted)) #end if #if $cutoff: #silent $mothur_args.append("cutoff=" + str($cutoff)) #end if #if $method_condition.method_switch == "distance": #silent $mothur_args.append("method=distance") #if $method_condition.matrix_condition.matrix_format == "column": #silent $mothur_args.append("column=dist.dat") #if $method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.names"): #silent $mothur_args.append("name=nameOrCount.dat") #elif $method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.count_table"): #silent $mothur_args.append("count=nameOrCount.dat") #end if #elif $method_condition.matrix_condition.matrix_format == "phylip": #silent $mothur_args.append("phylip=dist.dat") #if $method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount: #if $method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.names"): #silent $mothur_args.append("name=nameOrCount.dat") #elif $method_condition.matrix_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.count_table"): #silent $mothur_args.append("count=nameOrCount.dat") #end if #end if #end if #if $method_condition.fasta: #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat") #end if #if $method_condition.pick.type == "yes": #if $method_condition.pick.group: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=group.dat") #end if #if $method_condition.pick.groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($method_condition.pick.groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if #end if #elif $method_condition.method_switch == "abundance": #silent $mothur_args.append("method=abundance") #if $method_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.names"): #silent $mothur_args.append("name=nameOrCount.dat") #elif $method_condition.nameOrCount.is_of_type("mothur.count_table"): #silent $mothur_args.append("count=nameOrCount.dat") #end if #end if
echo 'get.oturep(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.name: method_switch
param.label: Method to use for the selection of the representative sequences
param.help: The distance method finds the sequence with the smallest maximum distance to other sequences. The abundance method chooses the most abundant sequence in the OTU as the representative.

param.name: nameOrCount
param.label: name file or count table - Sequences Name reference

param.name: nameOrCount
param.label: name file or count table - Sequences Name reference

param.name: type
param.label: Parse a group file into abundant and rare groups?

param.name: group
param.label: group - Group file for the OTU List

param.name: groups
param.label: groups - Group Selection (all used if none are selected)

param.name: nameOrCount
param.label: name file or count table - Sequences Name reference

param.name: cutoff
param.label: cutoff - OTU label at which to pick representatives
param.help: As of mothur 1.48 the label parameter was replaced by cutoff; a range such as 0.01-0.03 selects several labels. Leave empty to use the last label in the list.

collection.name: names_out
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: rep.names
collection.filter: (method_condition['method_switch'] == "distance" and method_condition['matrix_condition'].get('nameOrCount') and method_condition['matrix_condition']['nameOrCount'].ext == "mothur.names" and method_condition['pick']['type'] == "no") or (method_condition['method_switch'] == "abundance" and method_condition['nameOrCount'].ext == "mothur.names")

collection.name: count_out
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: rep.count_table
collection.filter: (method_condition['method_switch'] == "distance" and ((method_condition['matrix_condition'].get('nameOrCount') and method_condition['matrix_condition']['nameOrCount'].ext == "mothur.count_table") or method_condition['pick']['type'] == "yes")) or (method_condition['method_switch'] == "abundance" and method_condition['nameOrCount'].ext == "mothur.count_table")

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.oturep_ command generates a fasta-formatted sequence file containing only a representative sequence for each OTU. The opposite of the bin.seqs command.
.. _get.oturep: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.oturep/
**Changes in mothur 1.48**
* The ``label`` parameter was replaced by ``cutoff``, which now also selects the OTU label(s) from the list file (``cutoff=0.01-0.03`` selects two labels). * mothur 1.48 always reads the *first* label of the list file, regardless of the ``cutoff`` given (an upstream bug). Real mothur list files store the ``unique`` label last, so in practice the ``unique`` representatives are written. * Adding a group file makes mothur convert a name file into a count table on the fly, so the results are written as ``*.rep.count_table`` files. * The ``groups`` selection (in addition to a group file) is broken upstream: mothur aborts with ``[ERROR]: <sequence> is not in your count table`` whenever it has to subset the representatives by group. Run the tool once per group subset instead (e.g. by splitting the group file).
v1.23.0: Updated to Mothur 1.33, added count and method parameter
